[Granik speaks in an alien language]
"''It's the confidence that's irritating.''"|formatting=0|Granik and Xanwan|audio=Granik-Xanwan-Irritating.flac|}} '''Granik''' was a surly [[alien]] who worked as a dispatcher at [[Xanwan's freight kiosk]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]. In [[5 BBY]], he discussed a notice put out by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] corporation with the kiosk's proprietor, [[Xanwan]]. The notice mentioned the world [[Kenari]], which Garnik had not heard of. Xanwan looked up the planet and read out its record to Granik before interacting with the customer [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|I'm just… I'm looking up Kenari.''"
"''Wha…What's that?''"
"''Yeah. He never heard of it either.|Xanwan and Andor discuss Granik's lack of knowledge on Kenari|audio=Xanwan-Andor-Kenari.flac|}} [[File:XanwansFreighKioskLong-A2.png|thumb|right|300px|Granik worked at Xanwan's freight kiosk on Ferrix.]] Granik was a resident of the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] who worked at [[Xanwan's freight kiosk]], serving as a dispatcher for the [[human]] proprietor, [[Xanwan]]. While he and Xanwan were working behind the kiosk in [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|102}} the pair discussed a notice put out by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] corporation seeking a [[Kenari (people)|Kenari]] male for questioning as part of a [[Death|murder]] inquiry. Granik had never heard of the world [[Kenari]], so Xanwan began to look it up as the colleagues squabbled. [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], the man the corporation was searching for, approached the kiosk just as Xanwan pulled up information on Kenari, which the proprietor explained was a [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] world that records said had been abandoned after a [[mining]] accident. After Xanwan told Granik that the corporation was not offering any reward, the [[alien]] moved further back into the building while Andor arranged with Xanwan to discreetly depart Ferrix for [[Tassar]] an [[Standard hour|hour]] later. Once Andor left the kiosk, Granik approached Xanwan again and annoyed him by bringing up a topic that the human told the alien to let go before Granik left him alone to stew. [[File:XanwanGranik-A2.png|thumb|left|300px|Granik worked with Xanwan.]] Before Andor returned for the journey, [[Corporate Tactical Forces]] arrived on Ferrix searching for him, causing the local residents to begin sounding an alarm and clearing the streets. As Granik shouted, Xanwan closed shop and lowered the shutters of the kiosk. Andor soon came into [[Ambush on Ferrix|conflict]] with the corporate forces but ultimately found another way off-world.{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|[Granik speaks in an alien language]
"''Will you let it go.''"
[Granik speaks in an alien language]|formatting=0|Granik annoys Xanwan|audio=Granik-Xanwan-LetItGo.flac|}} Granik was a surly and diminutive{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{AD|Disney+}} alien with [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and brown skin. He used an alien [[language]] when speaking to Xanwan, although the human responded in [[Galactic Basic Standard|basic]]. ==Equipment== Granik wore a hooded brown [[Clothing|outfit]] with black sleeves and a red [[jacket]] over it. ==Behind the scenes== Granik was created for the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] episode "[[That Would Be Me]]," which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} The character's name was not spoken in the episode, but it was given in the subtitles and listed in the credits. He was portrayed by [[Kiran Shah]], who previously worked on many ''[[Star Wars]]'' films. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Granik|soundcat=Audio files of Granik}} *{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} {{Voice}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-2-episode-guide|text="That Would Be Me" Episode Guide | Andor}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Granik |es=Granik |ja=グラニック |ka=გრენიკი |pl=Granik }} [[Category:Ferrixians]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
